1.explanation: These files together manage filter state and render the Clear Filters control. Data.js is the high-level component that holds filter/search state and provides context. filter.js contains the logic that applies and resets filters on the data set. DataFilters/DataFilters.js is responsible for rendering the filter UI and should render the Clear Filters button when any filters are active. index.js for DataFilters just re-exports that component. A bug in this flow is causing the clear control never to be injected into the toolbar at the proper time/place.
1.bug_scenario: In our Data component example we wire up DataSearch and DataFilters inside a Toolbar and expect that, as soon as the user types in the search box or opens/applies one of the filters, a “Clear Filters” control will automatically appear alongside those controls (matching the behavior shown in the Grommet Filtering With Select and Filtering With Layer examples). Instead, no Clear Filters button shows up in the toolbar after interacting, and in some UIs we’ve resorted to putting a manual top-level Button outside the Data control—which is neither automatic nor positioned correctly.

2.explanation:
• Data.js: This is the root Data component that wires up context, state, and how children (Toolbar, DataSearch, DataFilters, List, etc.) interact. It contains the logic that should automatically detect active filters or search terms and inject the Clear Filters button into the toolbar—this logic is broken or missing.

• DataFilters.js: This file drives the filter UIs (Drop, Inline, Layer) and should notify Data.js when filters are applied or cleared. It also renders its own “Clear all filters” button inside a layer or inline block but doesn’t propagate that back to the toolbar.

• DataSearch.js: The search input component applies a text filter to Data’s state but does not trigger the toolbar’s Clear Filters button to appear when the user types a search term.

• filter.js: Contains the core filter-state management—adding, removing, and clearing filters. The Clear Filters control ultimately calls into this module, so any missing calls or mis-wiring here will prevent clearing and hiding the button appropriately.
2.bug_scenario: When using the Data component with DataSearch and DataFilters inside a Toolbar (e.g. in the “Filtering with Select” or “Filters in a Center Layer” templates), the “Clear Filters” control doesn’t appear automatically when the user types into the search box or opens/applies a filter. It was promoted to a top-level component in our example but never rendered alongside the built-in DataToolbar controls.
